ephemeral-updates: apply updateMessageEphemeralContent over time (#179)

* Slice: apply updateMessageEphemeralContent (ephemeral content refreshes over time) [parity:msg-ephemeral-updates]

- envelope: new UpdateMessageEphemeralContent variant + parse arm on the
  existing parse_payload match (td_api.tl:10424); missing ephemeral_content
  drops the update (MissingField)
- state: update_ephemeral on HistoryState + reducer arm mirroring
  UpdateMessageContent — replaces the stored ephemeral content in place,
  refreshes chat.last_preview when it is the last message (ephemeral wins
  via effective_content)
- tests: parse test (envelope) + reducer test (synthetic update through
  apply_json asserts stored content and preview)
- README: parity:msg-ephemeral-updates checked
- Waiver bumps (exact, post-fmt): state.rs 21654->21754, envelope.rs
  18600->18649 — type-coherent extensions only (new enum variant, new
  match arms on existing matches, new method on existing type)

* ephemeral-updates: review fixups — move tests to tests/ephemeral_updates.rs, shrink waivers to type-coherent deltas

- tests: both slice tests moved out of the waived files into
  tests/ephemeral_updates.rs, driven through public APIs only (per the
  tests/sticker_dynamic_order.rs template); the in-module test fns in
  src/state.rs and src/telegram/envelope.rs are deleted
- waivers: exact post-fmt type-coherent deltas — state.rs 21654->21701
  (+47: update_ephemeral method + reducer match arm), envelope.rs
  18600->18615 (+15: UpdateMessageEphemeralContent variant + parse arm);
  comment fixed, test-growth justification dropped
- parity 404/525 (77.0%) — README has 404 checked boxes; the previous
  commit's 406/525 was a miscount, not repeated here

* Merge-pipeline: rebase post-#178; exact waiver baselines

* Merge-pipeline: add ephemeral-updates DECISIONS.md section

* Merge-pipeline: fix null ephemeral_content semantics (review finding)

Schema-legal explicit null clears the stored ephemeral content instead of
dropping the update as MissingField. Variant field -> Option, parse arm
distinguishes present-null (None) from missing/mistyped (MissingField),
update_ephemeral takes Option and assigns. Null-case test added.

Exact waiver bumps (type-coherent): state.rs 21768->21773 (+5),
envelope.rs 18619->18633 (+14).

* Merge-pipeline: DECISIONS.md reflects final +52/+29 deltas and null semantics

Slice S16: fix emoji sticker_type (stickerTypeEmoji -> stickerTypeCustomEmoji) (#175)

stickerTypeEmoji does not exist in the pinned TDLib 1.8.67 schema
(StickerType = Regular/Mask/CustomEmoji only, td_api.tl:412-421), so the
five emoji-set request builders (getInstalled/Archived/Trending/Search/
ReorderStickerSets) were sending a bogus type TDLib 400s. The emoji panel's
installed/archived/trending/search/reorder fetches were broken in production.
Fix is a rename to stickerTypeCustomEmoji in the builders, fixtures,
comments, and the parity:emoji-custom-packs README parenthetical. No new
README boxes (bug fix); no waiver bumps (line-neutral).

Co-authored-by: shinycake <shinycake@users.noreply.github.com>

platform-tray-icon: system tray icon with unread count (#174)

* platform-tray-icon: system tray icon with unread count

Pivoted from A11 (auth-qr-authorize-other): TDLib 1.8.67 cannot mint a
login token for another device from an authorized client
(requestQrCodeAuthentication is WaitPhoneNumber-only; confirmQrCodeAuthentication
is scan-only; the only auth.exportLoginToken call site is create_unauth).
Full evidence in DECISIONS.md; the QR box stays unchecked honestly.

New named module src/tray.rs: total_unread (saturating sum over chats),
programmatic 64x64 RGBA icon (blue rounded square + paper-plane glyph, no
asset files), red unread pill capped at 99+, tray-icon 0.21 handle with
change-only re-render and tooltip, sync_tray on a process-wide handle that
retries creation until the OS tray exists (silent no-op otherwise).
src/main.rs: 1s UI-thread timer syncs the tray via WeakEntity.
src/ui/mod.rs: zero line growth (48465) — only fn session -> pub(crate) fn
session (line-neutral). tray-menu / minimize-to-tray / start-minimized /
app-icon-badge / updater boxes untouched.

README: parity:platform-tray-icon checked.

* platform-tray-icon: reviewer fixups (F2-F5)

F2: badge excludes effectively muted chats via Session::effective_muted
(same gate as the notification toast) — matches Telegram Desktop's default
('Include muted chats in unread count' is opt-in); module docs corrected
(the old 'official-client OS-badge semantics' claim was wrong).
F3: badge pill clamped by x0, not cx — no more 1px right-edge clip at >=10
unread; proof image re-rendered (~/workspace/tray-icons-proof.png).
F4: DECISIONS.md — thread_local RefCell (not OnceLock<Mutex>) and verified
td_api.tl refs (:11346, :11414, :9357).
F5: tooltip is a no-op on Linux (tray-icon docs) noted in README/DECISIONS.
Tests: muted chats excluded from total_unread.

* platform-tray-icon: cargo fmt

* platform-tray-icon: fix Cargo.lock libloading disambiguation after rebase

* platform-tray-icon: include muted chats in badge (Telegram Desktop's actual default)

The earlier F2 fixup claimed TD excludes muted by default ('opt-in').
That was factually wrong: tdesktop core_settings.h declares
_includeMutedCounter = true, and computeUnreadBadge includes muted marks
when the setting is on (the 'Include muted chats' toggle defaults ON).
total_unread now sums non-archived chats with muted included; archived
excluded (both clients exclude archived from the badge by default).
Tests + docs corrected.

* Fix review findings: correct DECISIONS.md line counts (ui/mod.rs 48851→48851 zero growth, src/main.rs +23)

Slice S15: dynamic sticker-set order (usage-driven) (#173)

* Slice S15: dynamic sticker-set order (usage-driven)

Sticker sends from the panel pass update_order_of_installed_sticker_sets=true
(schema 1.8.67:5928) so TDLib moves the used set to the front and broadcasts
updateInstalledStickerSets (schema:10932), which the state reducer applies in
place to the cached installed sets (sticker panel for regular sets, emoji
panel for other types). Picker lists stored order, so no UI change needed.

Waiver bumps (exact, coherent extensions that cannot live elsewhere):
- src/state.rs 21622 -> 21745 (reducer match arm + Session method + inline test)
- src/telegram/envelope.rs 18575 -> 18630 (envelope variant + parse arm + tests)
- src/telegram/requests.rs 10470 -> 10480 (send_sticker options + test assert)
- src/ui/mod.rs 48851 -> 48853 (SendOptions field init for text sends)

Slice S4: Settings → Data & Storage (auto-download, less-data calls, storage usage, clear cache) (#171)

* Slice S4: Data & Storage — auto-download settings, less-data calls, storage usage, clear cache

TDLib (pinned 1.8.67): setAutoDownloadSettings, getAutoDownloadSettingsPresets,
removeAllFilesFromDownloads, getStorageStatistics (chat_limit 50).

- New src/data_settings.rs: NetworkKind, complete AutoDownloadNetSettings
  (all 10 td_api.tl fields preserved on write), DataStoragePrefs with
  preset seeding (wifi=high, mobile=medium, roaming=low), account-local
  data_storage.json persistence, cap labels/cycling, StorageChatStats.
- New src/telegram/requests_data_settings.rs: request builders with

- New src/ui/dialogs/data_storage.rs: kit Dialog/Switch/Table overview,
  per-network editor, storage + per-chat tables, clear-cache confirmation.
- State: presets seed once (guarded by seeded + @extra), settings apply
  on confirmed ok (purpose carries the sent settings — never
  optimistically), clear success drops stats for refetch, errors surface
  on-screen (S3 pattern, never toasts).
- Shared 'Use less data for calls' toggle drives all three networks
  (TGX/TD behavior); obsolete local-only CallPrefs.less_data_for_calls
  removed.
- Screenshot ready-storage-usage.png refreshed; docs updated.

Waiver: src/state.rs 21012 -> 21018 (type-coherent: enum variant field
+ match arms on existing types). README: +4 boxes (376/525, 71.6%).

* fixup(s4): adversarial review findings 1-4 + housekeeping nits 5-7

Finding 1 (blocking): set_less_data_for_calls refuses while
data_storage is unseeded — the calls-tab toggle fired even before the
presets seeded, pushing auto-download disabled + zero caps for all
three networks account-wide. Choke-point guard in the driver covers
both toggles; the calls-tab on_click already maps Err -> status note.

Finding 2: set_auto_download_settings doc rewritten — it claimed
optimistic application; the code applies on confirmed ok only. The
setAccountTtl precedent (state.rs:8383) also applies on ok.

Finding 3: DECISIONS.md S4 entry — autoDownloadSettings has all 9
schema fields (not 8); storageStatistics.by_chat (not by_chats).

Finding 4: tests/data_storage.rs — apply-on-ok reducer coverage:
settings applied on ok (+ seeded/dirty flags), clear-cache ok drops
stats + flags cache_cleared, TDLib errors surface on
data_storage_error without applying.

Nit 5 (weighed, no change): local format_storage_bytes kept — the
shared format_bytes returns '' for 0 (load-bearing at ui/mod.rs:47591)
and has no GB branch; extending it would change other callers'
behavior. The duplicate stays documented where it is.

Nit 6: chat_id==0 storage row labeled 'Other chats' (the schema's
'all other chats grouped' bucket).

Nit 7: ui/mod.rs waiver 48465 -> 48432 (exact); connect.rs waiver
24153 -> 24159 (exact — type-coherent guard + doc in existing
methods, cannot live in a named module).

* fixup(s4): use i32::MAX 'No limit' sentinel; correct rebased waiver counts

Adversarial review: the 'No limit' size cap used i64::MAX, which exceeds
the TDLib wire bounds (max_photo_file_size:int32) — TDLib's
from_json(int32&) round-trip check rejects out-of-range values, so
selecting 'No limit' + Save deterministically 400s. New NO_LIMIT_SIZE_CAP
const (i32::MAX as i64) fits int32 and int53 alike; SIZE_CAP_STEPS,
size_cap_label, and the unit tests now use it.

Also corrects the rebase's waiver baselines to exact measured values:

counts; conflict resolution added one net line each), adds the missing
envelope.rs S4 justification comment, and confirms
scripts/check_file_sizes.sh passes locally.

* G9: community service message rows (join/added/removed)

Render the three community service messages as centered neutral rows
in session_history_row (schema 1.8.67, td_api.tl:5353-5363):

- messageChatAddedToCommunity -> 'This chat was added to community
  "NAME"' (name from the session updateCommunity cache) or the nameless
  fallback; TGX ActionChatAddedToCommunity{,Unknown} verbatim.
- messageChatRemovedFromCommunity -> 'This chat was removed from
  community'; TGX ActionChatRemovedFromCommunity verbatim.
- messageChatJoinFromCommunity (new MessageContent::ChatJoinFromCommunity
  { community_id } parse arm + chat-list preview 'Joined the group from
  the community') -> '{sender}/You joined the group from the community
  ["NAME"]'; TGX group_user_join_from_community* verbatim; the row
  keeps the sender uncollapsed (same rule as ScreenshotTaken).

No bubble, no reply/react/edit/delete; not caption-editable
(composer.rs arm); no extra media arm. TGX reference: TGMessageService.java
community constructors + strings.xml.

rule: new enum variant + new match arms on the existing row-dispatch

- src/ui/mod.rs 48465 -> 48531 (three service-row arms + sender/no-media/
